title: CE5 night in Sedona with Greer's team and Demi Lovato: orbs, gold disc craft and an unseen blow
place_text: Sedona, Arizona (off-grid site off a trail)

tellings.quote: So, we're sitting there, we're seeing orbs, we're seeing, you know, discshaped craft appear in and out.

plain: On a night at an off-grid site near Sedona, Arizona, Michael Herrera says he joined the team of a UFO activist named Steven Greer, with the singer Demi Lovato present, for a CE5 session, a group practice meant to call UFOs through meditation. He says they saw orbs and "discshaped craft" appearing and disappearing, among them a gold disc, and that someone was struck by a blow from something no one could see. Herrera, who says he once saw a huge UFO in the Indonesian jungle, tells Michels he was there.
